instruction.text: Choose the correct Roman numerals to make the sentence true.

atoms.a: Christmas is on the 25th day of the 12th month.
atoms.b: Christmas is on the ((++XXV XVX)) day of the ((++XII ++VVII)) month.

atoms.a: There are 28 days in February, but in a leap year there are 29 days.
atoms.b: There are ((++XXVIII IIXXX)) days in February, but in a leap year there are ((++XXIX IXXX)) days.

atoms.a: In every month except February, there are either 30 days or 31 days.
atoms.b: In every month except February, there are either ((++XXX XXVV)) days or ((++XXXI XXVVI)) days.

atoms.a: A quarter of an hour is 15 minutes and three-quarters of an hour is 45 minutes.
atoms.b: A quarter of an hour is ((++XV XXV)) minutes and three-quarters of an hour is ((++XLV LV)) minutes.
